082/**
083 * This class encapsulates the list and list data used for SwingSet
084 * list and combobox components.
085 * The class holds a reference to a {@code List<ListItem>} and
086 * it's method {@link #createListItem(java.lang.Object...) }
087is a factory that creates ListItem objects. It does not have public
088methods to modify the list; getRemodel and sub-classes provide that.
089Using {@link #install(javax.swing.JComponent, dev.visdb.seesaw.models.AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel, javax.swing.ListCellRenderer)} a proxy that delegates
090 * to this class is installed into a JList or JComboBox.
091 * <p>
092 * Where possible, this class and subclasses name methods
093 * similarly to the List interface, such as "add*", "remove*".
094 * <p>
095 * The encapsulated data can be thought of as a two dimensional
096 * array [ height X width ]; the height is the size of {@code List<ListItem>},
097the width is the number of elements in a ListItem .
098The number of elements in an ListItem is controlled by a property,
099see {@link #setItemNumElems};
100 * the property may only be changed when the item list is empty.
101 * <p>
102 * {@code createElementSlice} creates live, read-only, lists of
103the individual elements of an ListItem; it is [ height X 1 ].
104This live list track changes to the main list.
105The slice always has the same number of
106items as the main list.
107<p>
108The contents of an ListItem are read through the protected
109{@link ListItem0} interface. The contents are modified through
110 * methods in this class.
111 * <p>
112This class is not parameterized; all ListItem elements are Objects.
113It is expected that sub-classes are parameterized and cast as needed.
114<h2>Remodel</h2>
115 * Inspections and modifications of the item list, and of its SSListItems,
116 * are done through a Remodel Object see {@link #getRemodel() }. The
117 * remodel object is "try with resource" compatible and subclasses
118 * may implement locking in their implementations of takeWriteLock()
119 * and releaseWriteLock(). See {@link GlazedListsKeyDisplayValueInfo}
120 * for an example.
121 * <p>
122 * Compatible with GlazedLists AutoComplete feature;
123 * in which case an EventList is set in the constructor.
124 *
125 * See {@link GlazedListsKeyDisplayValueInfo} usage in SSDBCombox
126 *      for use Glazed AutoComplete feature
127 * @since 4.0.0
128 */
129//
130// There is an issue that arises from modifying the contents of a list item;
131// in this case, the list itself is not modified. There is a fireContentsChanged
132// event. This all is good when this is used as a model in a JComponent.
133// The setElem method is the only one that would modify a list item in place.
134//
135// However, when this is used to mangage a GlazedList, there is no event
136// listener. Glazed listens to changes in the EventList which this manages.
137// When working on a glazed list, a newListItem must be created and then
138// list.set(index, newListItem) and that notifies the event list. Note that
139// it is generally insufficient to do something like
140//     listItem = list.get(index)
141//     modify-listItem
142//     list.set(index, listItem)
143// becase if the set is optimized by currentListItem.equals(setListItem)
144// that will say that nothing is changed. So must create a new list item.
145//
146public abstract class AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel {
147  /** when true, handle combo box selected item (about the events) */
148  private boolean comboBoxModel;
149  /** this class (it's proxy) has been installed into a JComponent */
150  private boolean installed;
151  /** Install this when not using glazed, and send events through this */
152  private final ComboBoxModelProxy modelProxy;
153

218  /**
219   * Construct a info container; if the specified itemList is
220   * null an array list is created.
221   * Only use this constructor directly if you are sure you must.
222   * <p>
223   * If an itemList is passed in, <b>lose the reference</b>;
224   * if the list, or its contents, are modified directly
225   * then swing model events are lost.
226   * @param itemNumElems number of elements in an ListItem

229
230  protected AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel(int itemNumElems, List<ListItem> itemList) {
231    this.listItemFormatDelegate = new FormatDelegate();
232    if (itemList != null && !itemList.isEmpty()) {
233      throw new IllegalArgumentException("item list must be empty");
234    }
235
236    this.itemList = itemList != null ? itemList : new ArrayList<>();
237    this.itemNumElems = itemNumElems;
238    setupNumElems(itemNumElems);
239    this.modelProxy = new ComboBoxModelProxy();
240  }

261  static class EventLoggingDataListener implements ListDataListener {
262    private final ListModel<?> model;
263    public EventLoggingDataListener(ListModel<?> model) {
264      this.model = model;
265    }
266
267    private String getMsg(ListDataEvent e) {
268      int t = e.getType();
269      String eventString = sf("%s[%d,%d]",
270                              t == ListDataEvent.CONTENTS_CHANGED   ? "CH"
271                              : t == ListDataEvent.INTERVAL_ADDED   ? "ADD"
272                              : t == ListDataEvent.INTERVAL_REMOVED ? "REM"
273                                                                    : "?",
274                              e.getIndex0(), e.getIndex1());
275      return sf("%s: %s", objectID(model), eventString);
276    }
277
278    @Override
279    public void intervalAdded(ListDataEvent e) {
280      eventLogger.log(TRACE, () -> getMsg(e));
281    }
282
283    @Override
284    public void intervalRemoved(ListDataEvent e) {
285      eventLogger.log(TRACE, () -> getMsg(e));
286    }
287
288    @Override
289    public void contentsChanged(ListDataEvent e) {
290      eventLogger.log(TRACE, () -> getMsg(e));
291    }
292  }
293
294  /**
295   * If event logging is enabled, log the model
296   * unless the model is already logging.
297   * @param model the model to log
298   */
299  // TODO: refine method for adding a model; maybe custom String tag.
300  public static void addEventLogging(ListModel<?> model) {
301    Objects.requireNonNull(model);
302    if (!eventLogger.isLoggable(TRACE)) {
303      return;
304    }
305    if (weakModelSet == null) {
306      weakModelSet = Collections.newSetFromMap(new WeakHashMap<>());
307    }
308    if (weakModelSet.contains(model)) {
309      return;
310    }
311    weakModelSet.add(model);
312    model.addListDataListener(new EventLoggingDataListener(model));
313  }
314  private static Set<ListModel<?>> weakModelSet;

325  /**
326   * Special case usage, grab the model configured for a JComboBox.
327   * @param <T> model elements
328   * @param model the model source
329   * @return the model
330   */
331  protected static <T> MutableComboBoxModel<T> getSimpleComboBoxModel(
332      AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel model) {
333    if (model.installed) {
334      throw new IllegalStateException("model already installed");
335    }
336    model.installed = true;
337    model.comboBoxModel = true;
338    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
339    MutableComboBoxModel<T> m = (MutableComboBoxModel<T>) model.modelProxy;
340    return m;
341  }

349  protected static <T> ListModel<T> getSimpleListModel(AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel model) {
350    if (model.installed) {
351      throw new IllegalStateException("model already installed");
352    }
353    model.installed = true;
354    model.comboBoxModel = false;
355    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
356    ListModel<T> m = (ListModel<T>) model.modelProxy;

360  /**
361   * Creates and installs a ListCellRenderer into the JComponent. The new
362   * renderer uses {@link #getListItemFormat() }
363   * to get the value to render. The renderer is either
364   * a {@code DefaultListCellRenderer} or a {@code  BasicComboBoxRenderer}
365   * as appropriate.
366   * <p>
367   * The model is installed into the JComponent as a convenience.
368   *
369   * @param jc Jcomponent to set up with model; must be JList or JComboBox
370   * @param model associated model
371   */
372  public static void install(JComponent jc, AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel model) {
373    install(jc, model, null);
374  }
375
376  /**
377   * Installs the specified ListCellRenderer into the JComponent.
378   * The model is installed into the JComponent as a convenience.
379   * If render is null, a new renderer is created from model.
380   *
381   * @param jc Jcomponent to set up with model
382   * @param model associated model
383   * @param render list cell renderer, may be null
384   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if jc is not JList or JComboBox
385   */
386  @SuppressWarnings({"unchecked", "rawtypes"})
387  // TODO Remove warning suppression post Java 8.
388  public static void install(JComponent jc, AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel model,
389                             ListCellRenderer<?> render) {
390    Objects.requireNonNull(jc);
391    Objects.requireNonNull(model);
392    if (model.installed) {
393      throw new IllegalStateException("model already installed");
394    }
395
396    model.installed = true;
397
398    switch (jc) {
399      case JList jl -> {
400        ListCellRenderer<?> useRender = render == null ? model.new LocalListCellRenderer() : render;
401        jl.setCellRenderer(useRender);
402        jl.setModel(model.modelProxy);
403        model.comboBoxModel = false;
404      }
405      case JComboBox jcb -> {
406        ListCellRenderer<?> useRender
407            = render == null ? model.new LocalComboBoxCellRenderer() : render;
408        jcb.setRenderer(useRender);
409        jcb.setModel(model.modelProxy);
410        model.comboBoxModel = true;
411      }
412      default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("must be JList or JComboBox");
413    }
414  }

416  final private FormatDelegate listItemFormatDelegate;
417
418  /**
419   * When used with glazed lists, the format is set at install into combo
420   * time and can not be changed. So glazed installs FormatDelegate, and
421   * then setItemListFormat is set/changed as convenient.
422   * <p>
423   * If the format is changed after combo box initialization is complete,
424   * then it is up to the user to force the combo to redraw.
425   */
426  @SuppressWarnings("serial")
427  private static class FormatDelegate extends Format {
428    private ListItemFormat listItemFormat;
429
430    @Override
431    public StringBuffer format(Object obj, StringBuffer toAppendTo, FieldPosition pos) {
432      return listItemFormat != null ? listItemFormat.format(obj, toAppendTo, pos)
433                                    : toAppendTo.append(obj);
434    }
435
436    @Override
437    public Object parseObject(String source, ParsePosition pos) {
438      return listItemFormat != null ? listItemFormat.parseObject(source, pos) : source;
439    }
440  }
441
442  /**
443   * Delegates formatting on the fly.
444   * @return Format to install in the model
445   */
446  protected Format getListItemFormatDelegate() {
447    return listItemFormatDelegate;
448  }
449
450  /**
451   * Set the format to use with this model.
452   *
453   * @param listItemFormat the format used with this model
454   */
455  public void setListItemFormat(ListItemFormat listItemFormat) {
456    listItemFormatDelegate.listItemFormat = listItemFormat;
457    if (modelProxy != null && !itemList.isEmpty()) {
458      // assume everything changed
459      modelProxy.fire.doFireContentsChanged(this, 0, itemList.size() - 1);
460      modelProxy.fire.doFireContentsChanged(this, -1, -1);
461    }
462  }
463
464  /**
465   * Return the listItemFormat associated with this model.
466   * @return the associated listItemFormat
467   */
468  public ListItemFormat getListItemFormat() {
469    if (listItemFormatDelegate.listItemFormat == null) {
470      listItemFormatDelegate.listItemFormat = new ListItemFormat();
471    }
472    return listItemFormatDelegate.listItemFormat;
473  }

515  //
516  // A ComboBoxModelProxy is created during construction, see modelProxy.
517  // This proxy delegates to methods in the AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel,
518  // it's enclosing class. The proxy is not used when glazed.
519  //
520  // The list is managed/modified using a Remodel object.
521  // The Remodel has hooks for locking; the are used when
522  // Glazedlists and it's EventList are used,
523  // see GlazedListsKeyDisplayValueInfo.
524  //
525  // Locking is not provided when this class' proxy is installed
526  // into a JList/JComboBox.
527  // See https://github.com/bpangburn/swingset/issues/52
528  // For a discussion of how that might be achieved.
529
530  /**
531   * This interface provides a method to get the real
532   * model from the proxy model.
533   */
534  public interface ComboBoxListSwingModel {
535    /**
536     * Return the model being proxied.
537     * @return the model
538     */
539    AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel getComboBoxListSwingModel();
540  }

542  private interface ComboBoxListFireProxy {
543    void doFireContentsChanged(Object source, int index0, int index1);
544    void doFireIntervalAdded(Object source, int index0, int index1);
545    void doFireIntervalRemoved(Object source, int index0, int index1);
546  }
547
548  @SuppressWarnings("serial")
549  /*package-test*/
550  class ComboBoxModelProxy
551      extends DefaultComboBoxModel<ListItem> implements ComboBoxListSwingModel {
552    @Override
553    public AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel getComboBoxListSwingModel() {
554      return AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel.this;
555    }
556
557    private final ComboBoxListFireProxy fire = new ComboBoxListFireProxy() {
558      @Override
559      public void doFireContentsChanged(Object source, int index0, int index1) {
560        fireContentsChanged(source, index0, index1);
561      }
562
563      @Override
564      public void doFireIntervalAdded(Object source, int index0, int index1) {
565        fireIntervalAdded(source, index0, index1);
566      }
567
568      @Override
569      public void doFireIntervalRemoved(Object source, int index0, int index1) {
570        fireIntervalRemoved(source, index0, index1);
571      }
572    };
573
574    //
575    // ListModel
576    //
577
578    /** {@inheritDoc } */
579    @Override
580    public int getSize() {
581      return itemList.size();
582    }
583
584    /** {@inheritDoc } */
585    @Override
586    public ListItem getElementAt(int index) {
587      if (comboBoxModel) {
588        // The DefaultComboBoxModel never throws an exception.
589        if (index >= 0 && index < itemList.size())
590          return itemList.get(index);
591        return null;
592      }
593      // DefaultListModel might throw an exception
594      return itemList.get(index);
595    }
596
597    //
598    // ComboBoxModel
599    //
600
601    private ListItem selectedObject;
602
603    /** {@inheritDoc } */
604    @Override
605    public void setSelectedItem(Object anItem) {
606      // TODO: exception if not combo?
607      if (comboBoxModel) {
608        if (!Objects.equals(selectedObject, anItem)) {
609          if (anItem == null || anItem instanceof ListItem) {
610            selectedObject = (ListItem) anItem;
611            modelProxy.fire.doFireContentsChanged(this, -1, -1);
612          } else {
613            logger.log(WARNING, () -> "ComboBox#setSelectedItem(" + anItem + ") not SSListItem");
614          }
615        }
616      }
617    }
618
619    /** {@inheritDoc } */
620    @Override
621    public ListItem getSelectedItem() {
622      // TODO: exception if not combo?
623      return selectedObject;
624    }
625
626    //
627    // MutableComboBoxModel
628    // NOTE the helper methods for keeping selection:
629    //      comboAdjustSelectedAfterAdd and comboAdjustSelectedForRemove
630    //
631
632    /** {@inheritDoc } */
633    @Override
634    public void addElement(ListItem item) {
635      add(item);
636    }
637
638    /** {@inheritDoc } */
639    @Override
640    public void insertElementAt(ListItem item, int index) {
641      add(index, item);
642    }
643
644    /** {@inheritDoc } */
645    @Override
646    public void removeElement(Object obj) {
647      remove(obj);
648      if (!(obj instanceof ListItem)) {
649        logger.log(WARNING, () -> "ComboBox#removeElement(" + obj + ") not SSListItem");
650      }
651    }
652
653    /** {@inheritDoc } */
654    @Override
655    public void removeElementAt(int index) {
656      remove(index);
657    }
658
659    //
660    // DefaultComboBoxModel (make sure Vector never gets referenced)
661    //
662
663    /** {@inheritDoc} */
664    @Override
665    public void addAll(int index, Collection<? extends ListItem> c) {
666      internalAddAll(index, c);
667    }
668
669    /** {@inheritDoc} */
670    @Override
671    public void addAll(Collection<? extends ListItem> c) {
672      internalAddAll(c);
673    }
674
675    /** {@inheritDoc } */
676    @Override
677    public void removeAllElements() {
678      clear();
679    }
680
681    /** {@inheritDoc } */
682    @Override
683    public int getIndexOf(Object anObject) {
684      return itemList.indexOf(anObject);
685    }

688  //
689  // Helper methods for adjusting selected
690  //
691
692  /**
693   * After adding what becomes the only list item in the list
694   * adjust the selection if... See DefaultComboBoxModel
695   *
696   * @param item the item just added
697   */
698  private void comboAdjustSelectedAfterAdd(ListItem item) {
699    if (comboBoxModel) {
700      if (itemList.size() == 1 && modelProxy.selectedObject == null && item != null) {
701        modelProxy.setSelectedItem(item);
702      }
703    }
704  }
705
706  /**
707   * After adding to a list that was empty,
708   * adjust the selection if... See DefaultComboBoxModel
709   *
710   * @param oldSize the size before additions
711   */
712  private void comboAdjustSelectedAfterAdd(int oldSize) {
713    if (comboBoxModel) {
714      if (oldSize == 0) {
715        if (itemList.size() >= 1 && modelProxy.selectedObject == null) {
716          ListItem item = itemList.get(0);
717          if (item != null) {
718            modelProxy.setSelectedItem(item);
719          }
720        }
721      }
722    }
723  }
724
725  private void comboAdjustSelectedForRemove(int index) {
726    if (comboBoxModel) {
727      if (modelProxy.getElementAt(index) == modelProxy.selectedObject) {
728        if (index == 0) {
729          modelProxy.setSelectedItem(
730              modelProxy.getSize() == 1 ? null : modelProxy.getElementAt(index + 1));
731        } else {
732          modelProxy.setSelectedItem(modelProxy.getElementAt(index - 1));
733        }
734      }
735    }
736  }
737
738  private void comboAdjustSelectedForClear() {
739    // NOTE seems like should throw change event,
740    // but guess it's covered by the remove event.
741    modelProxy.selectedObject = null;
742  }

745  //

753  /**
754   * This is used to configure the number of elements in an SSListItem.
755   * The itemList must be empty.
756   *
757   * @param nElems number of elements, 1,2,3,4-30 supported
758   */
759  private void setupNumElems(int nElems) {
760    if (!itemList.isEmpty()) {
761      throw new IllegalArgumentException(
762          "Only change number of items in a ListItem, when SSItemList is empty");
763    }
764    if (nElems < 1 || nElems > 30) {
765      throw new IllegalArgumentException("Only [1:30] items in a ListItem handled, not " + nElems);
766    }
767    validElemsMask = 0;
768    Class<?> clazz = switch (nElems) {
769      case 1 -> ListItem1.class;
770      case 2 -> ListItem2.class;
771      case 3 -> ListItem3.class;
772      default -> ListItemAsArray.class;
773    };
774    try {
775      listItemConstructor = clazz.getConstructor((new Object[0]).getClass());
776    } catch (NoSuchMethodException | SecurityException ex) {
777      throw new RuntimeException("SSAbstractListInfo impossible", ex);
778    }
779    validElemsMask = (1 << nElems) - 1;
780
781    // Validate or invalidate any existing slices.
782    // Also toss cleared references.
783    for (Iterator<WeakReference<ItemElementSlice>> iterator = createdLists.iterator();
784         iterator.hasNext();) {
785      WeakReference<ItemElementSlice> elRef = iterator.next();
786      ItemElementSlice el = elRef.get();
787      if (el == null) {
788        iterator.remove();
789        continue;
790      }
791      el.isValid = el.elemIndex < nElems;
792    }
793  }
794
795  /**
796   * Retire any list slice that was garbage collected.
797   * Usually used for testing.
798   * A subclass may use this if it wants the affect.
799   * @return number of active/referenced list slices
800   */
801  protected int checkCreatedLists() {
802    // toss cleared references.
803    for (Iterator<WeakReference<ItemElementSlice>> iterator = createdLists.iterator();
804         iterator.hasNext();) {
805      WeakReference<ItemElementSlice> elRef = iterator.next();
806      ItemElementSlice el = elRef.get();
807      if (el == null) {
808        iterator.remove();
809      }
810    }
811    return createdLists.size();
812  }

881  /**

923  //
924  // Modifications, list or item.
925  //
926  // Typically should only be invoked from constructor or remodel.
927  //
928  // Exception is some combox model methods invoke directly.
929  // If the models want locking, thier methods must handle locking

931
932  private boolean add(ListItem listItem) {
933    int addAt = itemList.size();
934    boolean isChanged = itemList.add(listItem);
935    if (isChanged) {
936      modelProxy.fire.doFireIntervalAdded(this, addAt, addAt);
937      comboAdjustSelectedAfterAdd(listItem);
938    }
939    return isChanged;
940  }
941
942  private void add(int index, ListItem listItem) {
943    itemList.add(index, listItem);
944    modelProxy.fire.doFireIntervalAdded(this, index, index);
945    comboAdjustSelectedAfterAdd(listItem);
946  }
947
948  private boolean internalAddAll(Collection<? extends ListItem> newItems) {
949    // first new item goes here
950    int oldSize = itemList.size();
951    boolean isChanged = itemList.addAll(newItems);
952    if (isChanged) {
953      modelProxy.fire.doFireIntervalAdded(this, oldSize, itemList.size() - 1);
954      comboAdjustSelectedAfterAdd(oldSize);
955    }
956    return isChanged;
957  }
958
959  private boolean internalAddAll(int index, Collection<? extends ListItem> newItems) {
960    boolean isChanged = itemList.addAll(index, newItems);
961    int oldSize = itemList.size();
962    if (isChanged) {
963      modelProxy.fire.doFireIntervalAdded(this, index, index + newItems.size() - 1);
964      comboAdjustSelectedAfterAdd(oldSize);
965    }
966    return isChanged;
967  }
968
969  private ListItem set(int index, ListItem newItem) {
970    ListItem oldVal = itemList.set(index, newItem);
971    modelProxy.fire.doFireContentsChanged(this, index, index);
972    return oldVal;
973  }
974
975  private void clear() {
976    comboAdjustSelectedForClear();
977    if (!itemList.isEmpty()) {
978      int firstIndex = 0;
979      int lastIndex = itemList.size() - 1;
980      itemList.clear();
981      modelProxy.fire.doFireIntervalRemoved(this, firstIndex, lastIndex);
982    }
983  }
984
985  private ListItem remove(int index) {
986    comboAdjustSelectedForRemove(index);
987    ListItem item = itemList.remove(index);
988    modelProxy.fire.doFireIntervalRemoved(this, index, index);
989    return item;
990  }
991
992  private boolean remove(Object listItem) {
993    int index = itemList.indexOf(listItem);
994    if (index < 0) {
995      return false;
996    }
997    // following fires event
998    remove(index);
999    return true;
1000  }

1002  /**
1003   * Using the list item at the specified list item index,
1004   * replace an element in the list item at the specified position.
1005   * @param listItemIndex operate on the list item at this index
1006   * @param elemIndex index of elem to replace
1007   * @param newElem elem to put into the list item
1008   * @return the previous contents of the list item at the specified position
1009   */
1010  // NOTE: setElem(listItem, elemIndex, newElem)
1011  // is a problem because this method wants to modify something inside
1012  // of a listItem, so the listItem's identity, via '==',
1013  // doesn't change. Best way to insure that changes are
1014  // correctly detected is to make a listItem immutable.
1015  // So make a copy/clone of the listItem.
1016  //
1017  // I think this behavior can be conditional on whether or not
1018  // glazed is used or if this is actually installed as a model.
1019  // But it doesn't seem worth the testing for a miniscule performance gain.
1020  // Don't want to fire everything changed since that's
1021  // probably be a big performance loss in most cases.
1022  private Object setElem(int listItemIndex, int elemIndex, Object newElem) {
1023    ListItemWrite0 listItem = (ListItemWrite0) itemList.get(listItemIndex);
1024    try {
1025      listItem = (ListItemWrite0) listItem.clone();
1026    } catch (CloneNotSupportedException ex) {
1027    }
1028    Object oldElem = listItem.getElem(elemIndex);
1029    listItem.setElem(elemIndex, newElem);
1030    itemList.set(listItemIndex, listItem);
1031    modelProxy.fire.doFireContentsChanged(this, listItemIndex, listItemIndex);
1032    return oldElem;
1033  }
1034
1035  /**
1036   * for testing
1037   * @param listItem clone this
1038   * @return clone
1039   */
1040  ListItem getClone(ListItem listItem) {
1041    try {
1042      return (ListItem) ((ListItemWrite0) listItem).clone();
1043    } catch (CloneNotSupportedException ex) {
1044    }
1045    return null;
1046  }

1050  // Slices
1051  //
1052
1053  /**
1054   * This doesn't lock. Is that a problem?
1055   */
1056  private class ItemElementSlice extends AbstractList<Object> {
1057    private final int elemIndex;
1058    private final boolean isReadOnly = true; // NEVER TURN THIS OFF
1059    private boolean isValid;
1060
1061    public ItemElementSlice(int objectIndex) {
1062      this.elemIndex = objectIndex;
1063      isValid = (validElemsMask & (1 << elemIndex)) != 0;
1064    }
1065
1066    private boolean isShadow(AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel model) {
1067      return AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel.this == model;
1068    }
1069
1070    @Override
1071    public Object get(int index) {
1072      checkValid();
1073      return getElem(index, elemIndex);
1074    }
1075
1076    @Override
1077    public int size() {
1078      checkValid();
1079      return itemList.size();
1080    }
1081
1082    // THIS IS A NICE IDEA, IT DOES THROW EVENTS. BUT TOO EASY
1083    // TO CIRCUMVENT LOCKING WHILE MODIFYING
1084    @Override
1085    public Object set(int index, Object element) {
1086      checkValid();
1087      if (isReadOnly) {
1088        return super.set(index, element);
1089      }
1090      return setElem(index, elemIndex, element);
1091    }
1092
1093    private void checkValid() {
1094      if (!isValid) {
1095        throw new IllegalAccessError(
1096            sf("SSListItem element slice %d must be in [0:%d]", elemIndex, itemNumElems - 1));
1097      }
1098    }
1099  }

1101  /**
1102   * Create a list slice of the item list. There is no checking on the element index.
1103   * <p>
1104   * If a returned element slice is not valid according to the
1105   * itemNumElems property, {@link #setItemNumElems},
1106   * then an attempt to use that slice
1107   * causes an exception. An element slice becomes valid/invalid
1108   * dynamically as itemNumElems changes.
1109   * @param <T> list type
1110   * @param elemIndex position in {@code ListItem} of elements
1111   * @return list of elements at the specified position
1112   */
1113  protected <T> List<T> createElementSlice(int elemIndex) {
1114    if (elemIndex < 0) {
1115      throw new IllegalArgumentException("elemIndex must be positive");
1116    }
1117    ItemElementSlice el = new ItemElementSlice(elemIndex);
1118    createdLists.add(new WeakReference<>(el));
1119    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
1120    List<T> l = (List<T>) el;
1121    return l;
1122  }
1123
1124  /**
1125   * Determine if the argument list is a slice of this item list.
1126   * A slice is a live list of an SSListItem element;
1127   * it is backed by an item list.
1128   * <p>
1129   * Note that if the list is a slice from a different item list,
1130   * then false is returned.
1131   * @param list check this list
1132   * @return true if the specified list is backed by this
1133   */
1134  public boolean hasShadow(List<?> list) {
1135    if (list instanceof ItemElementSlice slice) {
1136      return slice.isShadow(this);
1137    }
1138    return false;
1139  }
1140
1141  /**
1142   * This method checks if the specified list is
1143   * a shadow of this itemlist.
1144   * If it is a shadow, then a copy of the list is created.
1145   * @see #hasShadow(java.util.List)
1146   * @param <T> type of list element
1147   * @param list list to check
1148   * @return a list disconnected from the item list.
1149   */
1150  public <T> List<T> getDisconnectedList(List<T> list) {
1151    return hasShadow(list) ? new ArrayList<>(list) : list;
1152  }

1164  //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
1165  //
1166  // Remodel
1167  //
1168
1169  /**
1170   * This is called by {@link Remodel#verifyOpened()} which
1171   * is called by every method in Remodel. For debug or otherwise
1172   * consistency checks can be placed in this method.
1173   */
1174  protected abstract void checkState();
1175
1176  /**
1177   * Remodel may be called from a remodel, this depends on reenterant
1178   * locks.
1179   * There may be more than one remodel active at a time and they
1180   * may be nested. They all share the same lock (if there's locking).
1181   * These counters essentially count the reentrant 
1182   */
1183  private int countLocksHeld;
1184  private int maxLocksHeld;
1185
1186  /**
1187   * Track the depth of taken reentrent lock, and adjust remodel.isClosed.
1188   * This is invoked during Remodel construction, be careful.
1189   * If a sub-class has real locking, the lock should be taken
1190   * before super... call to here.
1191   * This method is responsible for incrementing countOpens
1192   * Other than that, if there is no locking then implement an empty method
1193   * @param remodel if null, then manual take
1194   */
1195  protected void remodelTakeWriteLock(Remodel remodel) {
1196    if (++countLocksHeld > maxLocksHeld)
1197      maxLocksHeld = countLocksHeld;
1198    if (remodel != null)
1199      remodel.isClosed = false;
1200  }
1201
1202  /**
1203   * Track the depth of taken reentrent lock, and adjust remodel.isClosed.
1204   * This is invoked during Remodel close.
1205   * <p>
1206   * This method is responsible for decrementing countOpens
1207   * {@code remodel.isClosed = true}
1208   * to prevent re-use
1209   * @param remodel if null, then manual release
1210   */
1211  protected void remodelReleaseWriteLock(Remodel remodel) {
1212    countLocksHeld--;
1213    if (countLocksHeld < 0)
1214      throw new IllegalStateException("Too many remodel unlocks: "+objectID(remodel));
1215    if (countLocksHeld == 0) {
1216      logger.log(DEBUG, () ->
1217          sf("Remodel %s unlocked, max %d", objectID(remodel), maxLocksHeld));
1218      maxLocksHeld = 0;
1219    }
1220    if (remodel != null) {
1221      if (remodel.isClosed)
1222        throw new IllegalStateException("Remodel already closed: "+objectID(remodel));
1223      remodel.isClosed = true;
1224    }
1225  }
1226
1227  /**
1228   * For debug. Throw if any locks are held.
1229   * @param remodel 
1230   */
1231  public void verifyNoLocksHeld(Remodel remodel) {
1232    if (countLocksHeld != 0)
1233      throw new IllegalStateException(
1234          sf("%s: countLocksHeld %d", objectID(remodel), countLocksHeld));
1235    if (remodel != null && !remodel.isClosed)
1236      throw new IllegalStateException(sf("%s: is not closed", objectID(remodel)));
1237  }
1238
1239  /**
1240   * For debug. Return count of locks held (reentrant).
1241   * @return 
1242   */
1243  public int checkLocksHeld() {
1244    return countLocksHeld;
1245  }

1248  /**
1249   * This returns a Remodel which has method for
1250   * reading and writing the itemList and its contained listItems.
1251   * <p>
1252   * This is typically used in a try with resources
1253   * {@snippet :
1254   *     class ListInfo extends XxxListInfo {...}
1255   *
1256   *     try (ListInfo.Remodel remodel = listInfo.getRemodel()) {
1257   *        // examine and modify the list info
1258   *        if (!remodel.isEmpty()) { ... }
1259   *        else { ... }
1260   *     }
1261   * }
1262   *
1263   * @return a Remodel permit
1264   */

1267  // /**
1268  //  * This must be called after a modification.

1277  /**
1278   * This provides methods to perform inspections and
1279   * modification of XxxListInfo.
1280   * It is anticipated that subclass may want to use Remodel
1281   * as part of a locking scheme for multi-threaded
1282   * access to AbstractComboBoxListSwingModel.
1283   * The {@link #verifyOpened()}
1284   * method is useful for that.
1285   * Typically methods in a subclass invoke
1286   * super.someMethod which does {@code verifyOpened()}.
1287   * If a method in a subclass directly modifies
1288   * the item list or its contents it should call verifyOpened
1289   * as its first statement; this avoids modifications
1290   * after the lock is released.
1291   * <p>
1292   * This pattern should be used when working with the list to guarantee
1293   * exclusive access. It avoids many potential synchronization problems.
1294   * {@snippet lang="java" :
1295   *     try (Model.remodel remodel = keyVis.getRemodel()) {
1296   *         // ...
1297   *     }
1298   * }
1299   * When there is no locking, getRemodel() is fast; there is minimal overhead.
1300   * <p>
1301   * See {@link GlazedListsKeyDisplayValueInfo} for example of Remodel locking
1302   */
1303  protected abstract class Remodel implements AutoCloseable {
1304    /**
1305     * Has this been closed? Error if access while closed.
1306     * Start closed, gets opened when the lock is taken.
1307     */
1308    protected boolean isClosed = true;
1309    /** Track number of opens to detect usage when not open errors. */
1310
1311    // /** if optimized indexOfItem, following means must rebuild optimizations */
1312    // protected boolean isModifiedLength = false;
1313
1314    /** a Remodel */
1315    protected Remodel() {
1316      remodelTakeWriteLock(this);
1317    }
1318
1319    /**
1320     * First statement of each method. Prevents use after close/unlock.
1321     *
1322     * @throws IllegalStateException if this Remodel is closed
1323     */
1324    protected void verifyOpened() {
1325      if (isClosed) {
1326        throw new IllegalStateException("Remodel completed; can not reuse: "+objectID(this));
1327      }
1328      checkState();
1329    }
1330
1331    // /** if optimized indexOfItem, following means must rebuild optimizations */
1332    // protected boolean isModifiedLength = false;
1333
1334    /**
1335     * Get a read only reference to the item list managed by this container
1336     * @return the item list
1337     */
1338    public List<ListItem> getItemList() {
1339      verifyOpened();
1340      return readOnlyItemList;
1341    }

1343    /** @return true if there are no list items in the item list */
1344    public boolean isEmpty() {
1345      verifyOpened();
1346      return itemList.isEmpty();
1347    }

1416    /**
1417     * Replaces the item at the specified position in the list
1418     * with the specified item.

1511  //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
1512  //
1513  // The ListItem container interface
1514  // and containers for an ListItem
1515  //
1516
1517  /**
1518   * The access methods for an SSListItem.
1519   * An SSListItem typically has 1, 2 or 3 Objects in it.
1520   * The first Object is often a key column value, the next
1521   * 1 or 2 objects are typically database column values related to the key.
1522   */
1523  protected interface ListItem0 extends ListItem {
1524    /**
1525     * Get an item from the SSListItem.
1526     * <p>
1527     * Typically index == 0 is a primary key
1528     *
1529     * @param index which item to get
1530     * @return the object from the ListItem
1531     */
1532    Object getElem(int index);
1533
1534    /**
1535     * @return a clone
1536     * @throws CloneNotSupportedException
1537     */
1538
1539    Object clone() throws CloneNotSupportedException;
1540  }
1541
1542  private interface ListItemWrite0 extends ListItem0, Cloneable {
1543    /**
1544     * Put an object into the ListItem.
1545     * @param index which item to set
1546     * @param object the object to put into the ListItem
1547     */
1548    void setElem(int index, Object object);
1549  }
1550
1551  //
1552  // DO NOT LOOK BELOW THIS LINE
1553  //
1554  /////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
1555  //
1556  // Use one of the following object, ListItem2 or ListItem3,
1557  // for an ListItem depending on 2 or 3 objects in the list item.
1558  // Note that this is smaller that having an array.
1559  //
1560  // If want to handle 4 objects, might use an array. See ListItemAsArray below
1561  // That's a container object + 4 data object + array object = 6 objects;
1562  // around 17% of storage, the array object, is unneeded overhead.
1563  //
1564
1565  /**
1566   * An ListItem with 1 Objects.
1567   */
1568  private static class ListItem1 implements ListItemWrite0, Cloneable {
1569    Object arg0;
1570
1571    @SuppressWarnings("unused")
1572    // TODO Unused warning is a false positive. Used by reflection.
1573    public ListItem1(Object[] elems) {
1574      arg0 = elems[0];
1575    }
1576
1577    private static void checkIndex(int index) {
1578      if (index != 0) {
1579        throw new ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException("Only 0 index available for this ListItem, not "
1580                                                 + index);
1581      }
1582    }
1583
1584    @Override
1585    public Object getElem(int index) {
1586      checkIndex(index);
1587      return arg0;
1588    }
1589
1590    @Override
1591    public void setElem(int index, Object object) {
1592      checkIndex(index);
1593      arg0 = object;
1594    }
1595
1596    @Override
1597    public String toString() {
1598      return "{" + arg0 + '}';
1599    }
1600
1601    @Override
1602    public int hashCode() {
1603      int hash = 7;
1604      hash = 67 * hash + Objects.hashCode(this.arg0);
1605      return hash;
1606    }
1607
1608    @Override
1609    public boolean equals(Object obj) {
1610      if (this == obj) {
1611        return true;
1612      }
1613      if (obj == null) {
1614        return false;
1615      }
1616      if (getClass() != obj.getClass()) {
1617        return false;
1618      }
1619      final ListItem1 other = (ListItem1) obj;
1620      return Objects.equals(this.arg0, other.arg0);
1621    }
1622
1623    @Override
1624    public Object clone() throws CloneNotSupportedException {
1625      return super.clone();
1626    }
1627  }
1628
1629  /**
1630   * An ListItem with 2 Objects.
1631   */
1632  private static class ListItem2 implements ListItemWrite0, Cloneable {
1633    Object arg0;
1634    Object arg1;
1635
1636    @SuppressWarnings("unused")
1637    // TODO Unused warning is a false positive. Used by reflection.
1638    public ListItem2(Object[] elems) {
1639      arg0 = elems[0];
1640      arg1 = elems[1];
1641    }
1642
1643    private static void checkIndex(int index) {
1644      if ((0b011 & (1 << index)) == 0) {
1645        throw new ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException(
1646            "Only 0 or 1 index available for this ListItem, not " + index);
1647      }
1648    }
1649
1650    @Override
1651    public Object getElem(int index) {
1652      checkIndex(index);
1653      return index == 0 ? arg0 : arg1;
1654    }
1655
1656    @Override
1657    public void setElem(int index, Object object) {
1658      checkIndex(index);
1659      if (index == 0)
1660        arg0 = object;
1661      else
1662        arg1 = object;
1663    }
1664
1665    @Override
1666    public String toString() {
1667      return "{" + arg0 + "," + arg1 + '}';
1668    }
1669
1670    @Override
1671    public int hashCode() {
1672      int hash = 3;
1673      hash = 19 * hash + Objects.hashCode(this.arg0);
1674      hash = 19 * hash + Objects.hashCode(this.arg1);
1675      return hash;
1676    }
1677
1678    @Override
1679    public boolean equals(Object obj) {
1680      if (this == obj) {
1681        return true;
1682      }
1683      if (obj == null) {
1684        return false;
1685      }
1686      if (getClass() != obj.getClass()) {
1687        return false;
1688      }
1689      final ListItem2 other = (ListItem2) obj;
1690      if (!Objects.equals(this.arg0, other.arg0)) {
1691        return false;
1692      }
1693      return Objects.equals(this.arg1, other.arg1);
1694    }
1695
1696    @Override
1697    public Object clone() throws CloneNotSupportedException {
1698      return super.clone();
1699    }
1700  }
1701
1702  /**
1703   * An ListItem with 3 Objects.
1704   */
1705  private static class ListItem3 implements ListItemWrite0, Cloneable {
1706    Object arg0;
1707    Object arg1;
1708    Object arg2;
1709
1710    @SuppressWarnings("unused")
1711    // TODO Unused warning is a false positive. Used by reflection.
1712    public ListItem3(Object[] elems) {
1713      arg0 = elems[0];
1714      arg1 = elems[1];
1715      arg2 = elems[2];
1716    }
1717
1718    private static void checkIndex(int index) {
1719      if ((0b0111 & (1 << index)) == 0) {
1720        throw new ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException(
1721            "Only 0, 1 or 2 index available for this ListItem, not " + index);
1722      }
1723    }
1724
1725    @Override
1726    public Object getElem(int index) {
1727      checkIndex(index);
1728      return index == 0 ? arg0 : index == 1 ? arg1 : arg2;
1729    }
1730
1731    @Override
1732    public void setElem(int index, Object object) {
1733      checkIndex(index);
1734      switch (index) {
1735        case 0 -> arg0 = object;
1736        case 1 -> arg1 = object;
1737        default -> arg2 = object;
1738      }
1739    }
1740
1741    @Override
1742    public String toString() {
1743      return "{" + arg0 + "," + arg1 + "," + arg2 + '}';
1744    }
1745
1746    @Override
1747    public int hashCode() {
1748      int hash = 3;
1749      hash = 47 * hash + Objects.hashCode(this.arg0);
1750      hash = 47 * hash + Objects.hashCode(this.arg1);
1751      hash = 47 * hash + Objects.hashCode(this.arg2);
1752      return hash;
1753    }
1754
1755    @Override
1756    public boolean equals(Object obj) {
1757      if (this == obj) {
1758        return true;
1759      }
1760      if (obj == null) {
1761        return false;
1762      }
1763      if (getClass() != obj.getClass()) {
1764        return false;
1765      }
1766      final ListItem3 other = (ListItem3) obj;
1767      if (!Objects.equals(this.arg0, other.arg0)) {
1768        return false;
1769      }
1770      if (!Objects.equals(this.arg1, other.arg1)) {
1771        return false;
1772      }
1773      return Objects.equals(this.arg2, other.arg2);
1774    }
1775
1776    @Override
1777    public Object clone() throws CloneNotSupportedException {
1778      return super.clone();
1779    }
1780  }
1781
1782  // This can be used for an arbitrary, but fixed, number of items
1783  // in an ListItem. Typically 4 or more items.
1784  private static class ListItemAsArray implements ListItemWrite0, Cloneable {
1785    Object[] elems;
1786
1787    @SuppressWarnings("unused")
1788    // TODO Unused warning is a false positive. Used by reflection.
1789    public ListItemAsArray(Object[] elems) {
1790      this.elems = Arrays.copyOf(elems, elems.length);
1791    }
1792
1793    @Override
1794    public Object getElem(int index) {
1795      return elems[index];
1796    }
1797
1798    @Override
1799    public void setElem(int index, Object object) {
1800      elems[index] = object;
1801    }
1802
1803    @Override
1804    public String toString() {
1805      return "{" + Arrays.toString(elems) + '}';
1806    }
1807
1808    @Override
1809    public int hashCode() {
1810      int hash = 7;
1811      hash = 83 * hash + Arrays.deepHashCode(elems);
1812      return hash;
1813    }
1814
1815    @Override
1816    public boolean equals(Object obj) {
1817      if (this == obj) {
1818        return true;
1819      }
1820      if (obj == null) {
1821        return false;
1822      }
1823      if (getClass() != obj.getClass()) {
1824        return false;
1825      }
1826      final ListItemAsArray other = (ListItemAsArray) obj;
1827      return Arrays.deepEquals(elems, other.elems);
1828    }
1829
1830    @Override
1831    public Object clone() throws CloneNotSupportedException {
1832      ListItemAsArray clone = (ListItemAsArray) super.clone();
1833      clone.elems = elems.clone();
1834      return clone;
1835    }
1836  }
1837}
